title: Floating the Penticton Channel - AN OKANAGAN MUST
description:
If you're headed to the Okanagan, or Penticton specifically, you must float down the Penticton Channel.  This lazy river connects Okanagan Lake to Skaha Lake and is the perfect way to spend a hot day.  Grab some friends, some floaties and relax down the river.  It is by far, the best way to enjoy an afternoon in the sun while in Penticton.  I can't recommend it enough.  You must float down the Penticton Channel.

Here is the floaty I just bought: http://amzn.to/2t51Lzd

Subscribe to be apart of future videos.  For photos, follow me on Instagram: @DownieLive

Thanks for watching!
-Mike
